blocks.text: CANBERRA — Australia’s major parties are being accused of missing an opportunity to address the country’s housing shortage by allowing more migrant apprentices to train in construction. The government, Coalition and One Nation have all announced plans in recent weeks to reduce Australia’s migrant intake, making migration an increasingly important political issue. While the parties differ on the role of international students and skilled workers, their plans have one thing in common: Australia’s student visa rules do not allow international students to undertake apprenticeships.
